summary: Reconcile chunks_with_partners: code counts any chunk in an edge row, node 16 doc says anchors with a non-empty panel — pick one definition and make both agree

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content:
SPEC WAS STALE -- the divergence it describes never landed on main. The redefinition of chunks_with_partners (panels-based -> any chunk appearing in an edge row) came from the uncommitted draft this ticket tree was planned from; that draft was discarded when the work was re-split across todo:6acd96ba..509174c8. scripts/derive_parallels.py:648 still reads sum(1 for p in panels.values() if p), which is exactly what node 16 lines 148-154 describe. Nothing to reconcile.

THE REAL DEFECT IS NARROWER AND NEWER, and the cap created it. chunks_with_partners is computed from panels -- BEFORE cap_fan_in() runs -- so it counts chunks whose panel was non-empty at selection time, not chunks that survived into the export. Those diverge exactly when the cap darkens something. Measured at max_fan_in=100: summary.json and the run line both report 5,054/5,054 chunks have partners while 353 of those chunks have zero edges in edges_derived.jsonl. At the shipped 500 they agree (0 darkened), so this is latent today and bites whoever retightens the knob -- which the node-16 gate explicitly invites by telling the operator to read chunks_with_partners.

FIX: keep chunks_with_partners panels-based. It is the doc's meaning, and node 16 line 154 reads it as a TAG-COVERAGE signal (a low value means untagged/unscored chunks, e.g. plotinus-select-works-index at 107 of 752) -- redefining it against the export would blunt exactly that. Add a second, separately-named chunks_in_export counted from the final rows, and make the run line show both whenever they differ. Two questions, two numbers, neither overloaded.

resolution.note: Spec was stale (see analysis [0]) -- the redefinition never landed. Real defect: chunks_with_partners is pre-cap, so it cannot be read as what shipped. Kept it panels-based for the tag-coverage signal; added chunks_in_export and a run-line disclosure. Verified: at 500 both read 5,054; at 100 they read 5,054 vs 4,701 with 353 darkened.
